payload.title: Papyrus marketing site: 'Built with Papyrus' showcase page with a logo wall
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-10-20: the Papyrus marketing site (p.apyr.us product site, not the Papyrus publication) gets a page that proudly lists every site built on Papyrus, as a logo wall for social proof. Sites with a logo show the logo; others show the name. Honest framing: today almost all are Anthus's own sites (say so); design partners get featured as they join, then paying customers. The list is data managed in the CMS (one record per site: name, logo, URL, kind = Anthus / design partner / customer, ordering), not hard-coded, so new logos can be added without code. Built on the standard front end (a core 'showcase/logo wall' component usable by any site).
